PS: 一采最少6步，想要音质好一点就8步。

detailed_description:
The target video uses a warm, intimate morning lifestyle style with soft backlight, shallow depth of field, and a restrained color palette of beige, grey, and muted orange.
[Shot 1] A handheld medium shot frames <Subject 1> standing before an open wardrobe in warm backlight. She reaches for <Subject 2>, the beige knit cardigan, but <Subject 3>, the grey sweater, slips from an old hanger and falls to the floor. The camera holds still as the fabric lands with a soft thud.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle close-up of <Subject 1> crouching. She picks up <Subject 3> and runs her fingers along the shoulder seam, frowning at the pull marks. She says in a quiet, slightly exasperated off-screen voiceover, <d>[English] Third time this week.</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera follows her hand as she pulls open a wardrobe compartment and takes out <Subject 4>, the quiet-grey hanger with a dark-grey anti-slip grip. She holds it up and examines it briefly.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, a 100mm macro shot shows <Subject 3> being placed onto <Subject 4>. She smooths the shoulder flat, and the anti-slip grip bites into the knit with a single firm press. She says in the same off-screen voiceover, <d>[English] Same sweater. Different hanger.</d>
[Shot 5] At 00:13.000, a side medium shot in backlight shows <Subject 1> holding <Subject 4> with <Subject 3> hanging from it. She tilts and gently shakes the hanger; the sweater stays in place. She smiles softly.
[Shot 6] At 00:17.000, a slow lateral tracking shot follows her hands as she hangs five garments, including a silk slip, onto a full row of <Subject 4>. She says in the off-screen voiceover, <d>[English] Everything stays where I put it.</d>
[Shot 7] At 00:21.000, a medium shot shows <Subject 1> wearing <Subject 2> in front of a mirror, smoothing the shoulder line. A two-frame white flash cuts to a macro of <Subject 5>, the seasonal-orange hanger with its orange anti-slip grip, then returns to her turning toward the mirror.
[Shot 8] At 00:25.000, a fixed medium shot in warm light shows <Subject 1> closing the wardrobe door, glancing back at the neat row, picking up her bag, and walking out of frame. She says in the off-screen voiceover, <d>[English] Small thing. Better mornings.</d>

overall_soundscape:
Soft indoor room tone and the physical sounds of fabric landing, smooth sliding on a hanger, and a wardrobe door closing continue throughout the video.
